name: Ir.D.F. Woudagemaal (D.F. Wouda Steam Pumping Station)
description: The Wouda Pumping Station stands at Lemmer in Friesland, in the north of the Netherlands. Opened by Queen Wilhelmina in 1920, it is the largest steam-powered pumping station still working anywhere. It was built to drain excess water from the province, and it can move 4,000 cubic metres a minute. It still steps in a few times a year when water levels run exceptionally high.
